description:
Use this when the user wants the details of one project or clip that search found, or what was said in a
        video: "write show notes for this episode", "give me chapters / timestamps", "what did I say about the
        giveaway", "subtitles", "titles from my stream". id: from a search result ("projects:abc123", "library:abc123")
        or "transcript:<project_id>" (project_id from list_projects) for the video's timed transcript, "[m:ss] line"
        per caption in original-video time; "transcript:<project_id>@<seconds>" reads on from there (long videos come
        in pages; metadata.next says where). Write show notes, chapters, titles and hooks from the transcript only,
        never invented timestamps.
        Not for: downloading the video (get_download_link), listing many items (list_projects, list_clips) or why a
        clip was picked (explain_clips). Free and read only.
name: fetch
title: Fetch RipClip document
